about_the_game:
Ai Chan is a conversational AI-powered desktop assistant for both Windows and MacOS. To use this app, simply install LMStudio on your PC for the chat feature. If you're using Japanese and want voice responses, you'll need VoiceVOX installed.

For users who don’t have LMStudio or VoiceVOX installed, you can still access all features by purchasing in-app coins through the Steam store.

Features:

  • Chat with Ai Chan on a wide range of topics: study, jokes, common knowledge, or specialized topics like programming.

  • Execute commands like opening and closing apps (e.g., Notepad, Chrome, Paint) or websites (social media, video streaming).

  • Voice Mode: When enabled (using in-app coins in paid mode), Ai Chan can reply with voice. VoiceVOX is required if the user is in Japanese and has disabled paid mode.

  • Customization: Tailor Ai Chan’s voice and appearance to your liking.

  • Multilingual Support: Ai Chan can converse in multiple languages around the world.
